summary: Blackburn was named a backer of Rick Scott's June 2023 resolution embracing the IHRA definition, under which delegitimization of Israel is classified as antisemitism, and in October 2023 she posted an 'I Stand With Israel' statement on her Senate site. Vote for Peace, a guide evaluating candidates on human rights and war-lobby funding, lists her as opposed in the general. The IHRA sponsorship and her explicit Israel support position her against Palestinian justice as measured by anti-Zionist watchdogs.
